questions.question: What was to happen to the land every seventh year?
options: It was sold to the highest bidder
It rested (a Sabbath year, not sown)
It was divided among the tribes again
It was burned to clear the weeds
questions.answer: It rested (a Sabbath year, not sown)

questions.question: What was the fiftieth year called, when slaves were freed and land returned?
In the Year of Jubilee, property returned to its original family and slaves were freed.
Every seventh year the land was to have a _____ of rest.
